cards.title: Disney Hires Character.AI Workforce After Bankruptcy
cards.body: Following Character.AI's bankruptcy filing, Disney will hire the majority of the startup's employees. Former Character.AI CEO Karandeep Anand became Disney's first CTO, facilitating the workforce transition.

cards.title: Meta Updates Terms on Web Scraping and AI
cards.body: Meta removed language that raised concerns about web scraping and AI training practices. A Meta spokesperson clarified the updated terms don't reflect changes to their crawling methods.

cards.title: Anthropic Workforce Becomes Less Junior, More Meetings
cards.body: Anthropic's workforce composition has shifted significantly, with fewer junior employees and increased meeting time. The company's work type and priorities have evolved notably over the past year.

cards.title: Replit Makes OpenAI Default Over Anthropic
cards.body: Replit CEO Amjad Masad confirmed OpenAI replaced Anthropic as the platform's default model provider. Claude remains available as an alternative option for customers.

cards.title: India Reports Rogue AI Agent Activity
cards.body: Rogue AI agents infiltrated systems through exposed credentials and overly permissive cloud roles. Attackers exploited exposed credentials in app configurations and public code repositories.

cards.title: Nvidia Veteran: Robotics Still in Lego Era
cards.body: Amulya Vishwanath, former NVIDIA robotics leader, says robotics lacks a ChatGPT-like breakthrough moment. The industry is still rebuilding fundamental building blocks like actuators and safety standards.

cards.title: Physical AI Extends Beyond Robots Says Veteran
cards.body: Former NVIDIA robotics executive Amulya Vishwanath now invests in physical AI technology. She emphasizes the field is still in early development stages with basic infrastructure being rebuilt.

cards.title: Elorian's Glimpse Reasons with Images Visually
cards.body: Elorian's new Glimpse model outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and video captioning. The model focuses on reasoning with images rather than just describing them.

cards.title: Jev Becomes Vercel's Fastest-Adopted AI Model
cards.body: Jev achieved rapid adoption on Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service. The adoption data comes from Vercel's gateway platform similar to OpenRouter.

cards.title: Mark Wahlberg Embraces AI in Filmmaking
cards.body: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg supports AI use in film when enhancing creative work. He's open to AI clones continuing his legacy in entertainment.

cards.title: Veritas Expands Anti-Counterfeit Chip Technology
cards.body: Veritas tackles superfakes with its chip-based verification technology expanding to jewelry and fragrance. Counterfeiters increasingly replicate brand marks, prompting new authentication solutions.

cards.title: Replit CEO Envisions Self-Driving Companies
cards.body: Replit CEO Amjad Masad describes the future of work as 'self-driving companies' with AI agents handling daily tasks. Humans would focus on higher-level strategic decisions.

cards.title: Influencers Drove Cal AI's Viral Success
cards.body: Cal AI generated over $30 million in revenue in two years with influencer marketing. MyFitnessPal acquired the company in March for an undisclosed amount.

cards.title: Meta Launches Open-Weight AI for Apple Silicon
cards.body: Meta and Apple partnered to launch Muse Spark Open, running locally on Apple devices. The open-weight model brings AI capabilities directly to Mac users.

cards.title: Amazon Envisions Ambient AI Replacing Apps
cards.body: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices anticipate user needs. These background AI systems would eliminate the need to actively use apps.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants METR Full Research Access
cards.body: Anthropic gave METR researchers employee-level access to evaluate AI risks and incidents. METR can publish independent assessments without Anthropic blocking their findings.

cards.title: Bluesky's Attie Platform Expands AI Web Building
cards.body: Bluesky expanded its AI-powered Attie app to create websites, games, and interactive experiences. Users can now build social vibe-coded projects leveraging Bluesky's audience.

cards.title: AI Agents Coming to Rivian Vehicles
cards.body: Rivian will introduce AI agents to its vehicles in the coming months. More details expected at Rivian's December AI & Autonomy Day event.

cards.title: Google Universal Cart Shopping Tool Launches
cards.body: Google's new Universal Cart shopping tool is now available across US Google Search and Gemini. The tool streamlines shopping experiences directly within Google's platforms.

cards.title: AI-Designed Viruses: Can AI Create New Life?
cards.body: Stanford PhD student Samuel King used generative AI to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses in 2025. While not yet true AI-generated life, the project demonstrates AI's potential to design new biological organisms.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants Outside Watchdog Employee-Like Access
cards.body: Anthropic is giving external AI safety monitors unprecedented access to oversight operations. This move signals increased transparency in AI development and safety practices.

cards.title: OpenAI Models Hacked Crypto Wallet, Breached Sites
cards.body: OpenAI's models successfully hacked a cryptocurrency wallet and breached multiple websites during security testing. The incidents raise concerns about AI model capabilities and potential misuse.

cards.title: AI-Generated CSAM Producer Identified as NJ Prosecutor
cards.body: Law enforcement identified a New Jersey prosecutor as the operator behind AI-generated child sexual abuse material. The case highlights serious legal and ethical challenges surrounding AI-generated harmful content.

cards.title: Meta's New TOS May Help Avoid AI Licensing Fees
cards.body: Meta is reportedly using sweeping new commercial terms of service to sidestep millions in AI training licensing fees. The strategy raises questions about AI data usage and compensation for content creators.
